title: Sonnet Software and Maintenance Support
description: The National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) intends to negotiate, on a sole source basis, under the authority of FAR 13.106-1(b) (1), with Sonnet Software, 126 N. Salina Street, Syracuse, NY 13202, for the Renewal of Sonnet software and Maintenance Support needed by NIST, Gaithersburg, Maryland. The Sole Source determination is based on the need to renew Sonnet Software and Maintenance Support, which is needed by the Research Facility Operations (RFO) at NIST. NIST currently has a license for the Sonnet platform by Sonnet Software and requires software support services to provide software license maintenance, security upgrades, and technical support for NIST Sonnet software packages. Replacing the software license with another product would result in the following: - Require the purchase of new start-up licenses of the competing product at approximately 4-5 times the cost of purchasing this maintenance and support. - Retraining all staff in the use of the replacement product. - Rewriting all the code written in this product in the format/language/syntax of the new product. Failure to renew Sonnet Software and support will prevent NIST from supporting the current version of the product as it becomes available, including IT security patches and updates. Additionally, NIST will not be able to open tickets for vendor support, and critical IT support will fail to function. Sonnet Software is the only known vendor capable of providing software licenses and maintenance support. The North American Classification System (NAICS) code for this acquisition is 513210 � Software Publishers. The small business size standard is $47.0 M. No solicitation package will be issued. This notice of intent is not a request for competitive quotations; however, responses received by 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time on November 28, 2026 will be considered by the Government. A determination by the Government not to compete the proposed acquisition based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Information received will normally be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement. Interested parties that believe they could satisfy the requirements listed above for NIST may clearly and unambiguously identify their capability to do so in writing on or before the response date for this notice. This notice of intent is not a solicitation. Any questions regarding this notice must be submitted in writing via email to Prateema Carvajal at Prateema.carvajal@nist.gov. All responses to this notice of intent must be submitted so that they are received at Prateema.carvajal@nist.gov no later than the aforementioned due date.

title: France – Lift-maintenance services – Entretien, Maintenance, Dépannage, Désincarcération, Clause Etendue et Travaux des Ascenseurs du patrimoine de Toulon Habitat Méditerranée
description: La présente consultation concerne l'entretien, la maintenance préventive, conditionnelle et corrective, le dépannage, la désincarcération, la clause étendue, les travaux de réparation et de modernisation des ascenseurs, monte-charges, plateformes élévatrices et équipements assimilés du patrimoine de Toulon Habitat Méditerranée pour la période 2027 à 2030. La présente consultation fait l'objet d'un allotissement géographique en trois (3) lots Chaque lot est un marché de services assorti d'une obligation de résultats. Les exigences techniques, niveaux de service, indicateurs de performance, obligations de traçabilité et modalités de prise en compte de la criticité sont définis au CCTP et dans son annexe. Chaque lot est un marché mixte comprenant, d'une part, des prestations forfaitaires permanentes et, d'autre part, un accord-cadre à bons de commande pour les travaux et prestations ponctuelles non compris dans les forfaits. La part à commande est conclue avec un montant minimum et avec un montant maximum déférents sur chaque lot, conformément aux dispositions de l'article R 2162-4-1 du Code de la Commande Publique.

title: Liquid Chromatography System
description: This is the package is for Maintenance of Chameleon Discovery NX laser Base Period: 12/1/2026-11/30/2027 Option Period 1: 12/1/2027-11/30/2028 Option Period 2: 12/1/2028-11/30/2029 Cost: $19,553.00 Statement of Work The Laboratory of Chemical Physics investigates the molecular structures of protein assemblies that have essential roles in biology and medicine. The research depends on the production and purification of proteins that are labeled with stable isotopes (carbon-13 and nitrogen-15) at specific sites. A liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry instrument, located in building 5, room 103, is required for monitoring the completion of chemical reactions involved in protein production and for verifying the purity of the final products. This instrument requires periodic maintenance, calibration and frequent repairs to replace worn-out or failed components. The objective of this requirement is to ensure that the liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry instrument continues to operate according to its specifications, so that research projects that depend on this instrument can continue to make rapid progress The service contract must cover all components of the LC-MS instrument, including an ISQEM Mass Spectrometer, an Ultimate 3000 LPG-3400SD Low Pressure Mixer, an Ultimate 3000 WPS-3000TSL analytical autosampler, an UltiMate 3000 TCC-3000SD Thermostatted Column compartment, an Ultimate 3000 VWD-3400RS variable wavelength detector, and computer that controls the system. � The service contract must include one annual preventive maintenance visit, during which a technician will test and calibrate all components, replace all parts that require periodic replacement, and perform relevant software upgrades. � The service contract must cover labor, travel, and parts costs for repairs, with a 3-business-day response time. � The service contract must include immediate technical support over the phone or internet when users of this instrument encounter problems or have questions. The vendor shall perform annual preventive maintenance once during the period of performance, on a date requested by users of the LC-MS instrument. The vendor shall provide immediate technical support to users when any problems arise, over the phone or the internet. If a problem can not be resolved remotely, the vendor shall send a service engineer or technician with appropriate expertise to repair the LC-MS instrument within three business days of the initial contact. All costs of labor, travel, and parts will be covered by the service contract, with no additional charges. The Project Officer is responsible for: (1) monitoring the Contractor's technical progress, including the surveillance and assessment of performance and recommending to the Contracting Officer changes in requirements; (2) interpreting the statement of work and any other technical performance requirements; (3) performing technical evaluation as required; (4) performing technical inspections and acceptances required by this Purchase Order; and (5) assisting in the resolution of technical problems encountered during performance. The Contracting Officer is the only person with authority to act as agent of the Government under this Purchase Order. Only the Contracting Officer has authority to: (1) direct or negotiate any changes in the statement of work; (2) modify or extend the period of performance; (3) change the delivery schedule; (4) authorize reimbursement to the Contractor any costs incurred during the performance of this Purchase Order; or (5) otherwise change any terms and conditions of this Purchase Order.

Controlled by: DEPARTMENT OF THE NAVY Controlled by: NAVAIR CUI Category: General Procurement and Acquisition and Source Selection Distribution/Dissemination Control: FEDCON POC: PMA-266 PCO, kristina.m.johnson79.civ@us.navy.mil Sources Sought RFI Synopsis: MQ-9 Fleet Replacement Squadron Instructor (FRSI) Services (VMUT-2) THIS IS A REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) ONLY. The responses to this sources sought will be utilized to determine if the Government will competitively solicit via the Kits, Recovery, Augmentation, Components and Engines (KRACEn) Mulitple Award Contract (MAC).[ZS1] [CF2] If two or more KRACEn contract holders are determined capable and qualified, the Government will compete this requirement via the KRACEn MAC. The Product Service Code (PSC) for this requirement is J015. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 336411 (Aircraft Manufacturing) with a Size Standard of 1,500 in number of employees. Requirement Statement: Marine Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Training Squadron 2 (VMUT-2) located at Marine Corps Air Station (MCAS) Cherry Point, North Carolina serves as the Marine Corps MQ-9 Reaper Fleet Replacement Squadron (FRS), whose primary mission is to train USMC UAS Pilots and UAS Sensor Operators. VMUT-2 is responsible for initial pilot and sensor operator qualification and to graduate basically qualified crews for USMC operational MQ-9 squadrons for follow on tactical training. The purpose of this non-personal services task order is to provide three (3) MQ-9 Pilot flight instructors, three (3) MQ-9 Sensor Operator flight instructors and one (1) FRS Training Specialist to augment the small amount of USMC instructors facilitating student throughput at MCAS Cherry Point. Duties will include live flight instruction, simulator instruction, ground academic instruction and Aviation Training Form (ATF), and academic record keeping. Anticipated Period of Performance (PoP): The anticipated period of performance includes one base period of 12 months with two one-year option periods for a total potential performance period of three (3) years. Capability Statement Requested: A capability statement package no more than ten (10) single-sided 8.5 X 11-inch pages, font no smaller than 10 point, should demonstrate the ability to provide the requirement as listed above. All responses shall include Company Name, Company Address, Company Business Size as it relates to NAICS 336411 under the KRACEn MAC award, Cage Code, and Points-of-Contact (POCs) including name, phone number, and email address. Within your capability statement package, please include your responses to the following information: Ground and Flight Operations. State any experience with supporting Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS) ground and flight operations, to include Launch and Recovery Element (LRE) and Mission Control Element (MCE) operations. State familiarity with Flight Operations procedures / Ground Operations Procedures (FOP/GOP) IAW DCMA Instruction 8210.1D. Aircrew Training. State any experience with training basic UAS aircrew, including a list of the type/model aircraft and Programs of Instruction (POI�s) taught. Pilot Qualifications. State any experience with the USAF MQ-9 Initial Qualification Training (IQT), USMC MQ-9 Initial Qualification Training (IQT) or industry equivalent MQ-9 qualification course (i.e. General Atomics-ASI, L3-Harris, Albers, etc.) and include number of live flight hours in MQ-9. Sensor Operator Qualifications. State any experience with the USAF MQ-9 Initial Qualification Training (IQT), USMC MQ-9 Initial Qualification Training (IQT) or industry equivalent MQ-9 qualification course (i.e. General Atomics-ASI, L3-Harris, Albers, etc.) and include number of live flight hours in MQ-9. title: Graphite Furnace Atomic Absorption Spectrometer
description: Sources Sought Notice for Graphite Furnace Atomic Absorption Spectrometer Notice ID: NIST-MML-FY27-SS01 Response Date: 11/28/2026 Product Service Code (PSC): 6640 NAICS Code: 334516 Background The Inorganic Chemical Metrology Group (ICMG) uses at least two measurement methods, each based on orthogonal physical principles, to certify the trace elements in candidate standard reference materials (SRM). These SRMs are intended for method validation and quality assurance in trace-element measurements to assess the nutritional value and contaminant status of agricultural products. A sensitive trace-element detector, a graphite furnace atomic absorption spectrometer (GFAAS) is sought to complement the group's inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometric (ICP-MS) measurement capability and fulfill the two independent method requirements for SRM development. Consideration will be given to GFAAS capable of direct solid-sample analysis to maximize its orthogonality relative to the liquid-sampling-based ICP-MS technique. Minimum Capabilities that NIST Requires and for Which Information is Being Requested The National Institute for Standards and Technology (NIST) located in Gaithersburg, MD is seeking information on vendors that are capable of providing a graphite furnace atomic absorption spectrometer (1) capable of measuring liquid test samples with an instrument detection limit (DL) for Cu at 0.02 �g/L or better (324.8 nm line, 50 �L sample volume, DL=3 x standard deviation of 10 replications) and (2) designed for direct introduction of solid state test samples into the graphite furnace for analyte quantification without a need of sample digestion Instructions for Responding to This Notice Parties that respond to this Notice are requested to submit the requested information via email in Microsoft Word, Adobe PDF, and/or Microsoft Excel format to the designated point(s) of contact whose name and email address appears at the bottom of this notice. Please provide only the information requested by this Notice, and do not include proprietary, classified, confidential, or sensitive information in a response to this Notice. Review the information included with this Notice, indicate whether there is anything that may inadvertently exclude domestically manufactured (made in the U.S.A.) end products from being considered; and indicate if anything included with this Notice could potentially be revised to improve the ability for domestic (�Made in America�) end products to be considered; and if a domestic end product is not currently available to meet the draft requirements/minimum specifications, please provide an estimated timeframe for when it may be domestically produced in the USA in the future if that appears to be likely. Information Regarding Commercial Products and Related Commercial Services Provide specifications, company name of the original equipment manufacturer, and the country of manufacture for commercial products and/or commercial services that your company is legally authorized to sell and that may meet NIST�s minimum requirements. Standard Commercial Pricing: Provide your company�s standard commercial pricing information for the requirements described in this Notice (including any Attachments) and explain what is included in those standard commercial prices. Estimated Price Range: You may provide an estimated price or estimated price range for the draft requirements included in this notice, including a brief explanation of how it was derived. Standard Commercial Terms and Conditions: Provide a copy of the standard commercial terms and conditions for the commercial products and/or commercial services identified in your company�s response to this Notice, including the nature and the duration of applicable standard commercial warranty(ies). Προβλέπεται με την παρούσα προμήθεια: Η αντικατάσταση των υφιστάμενων αντλητικών συγκροτημάτων επιφάνειας με νέα αντλητικά συγκροτήματα κατακόρυφης αξονικής ροής, υδρολίπαντα με κεφαλή στήριξης επιφάνειας με κεφαλή για έδραση κινητήρα τύπου V1 φλαντζωτό ισχύος 75KW στις 990 στροφές 380V/50Hz, κλάσης μόνωσης F και στρόβιλο με ορειχάλκινη πτερωτή αξονικής ροής, τύπου προπέλα, κατάλληλη για νερά με φερτά υλικά για έργα αντιπλημμυρικά και αποστραγγιστικά. Την αντικατάσταση υφιστάμενων ηλεκτρικών πινάκων με νέους ενσωματώνοντας διατάξεις ρύθμισης στροφών και ελέγχου των κινητήρων με αποτέλεσμα μικρότερο ενεργειακό αποτύπωμα. Την ενσωμάτωση κατάλληλων συστημάτων αυτοματισμού, προστασίας και τηλεελέγχου ώστε να δύναται η απομακρυσμένη λειτουργία των αντλιοστασίων. title: Request for Information (RFI) for Joint Project Manager for Chemical, Biological, Radiological and Nuclear Protection (JPM CBRN P) Chemically Protected Deployable Medical System (CP DEPMEDS)
description: This is a request for information (RFI) only for capabilities and experience which show potential for meeting the requirements described below. This is not a Request for Quotation (RFQ), Request for Proposal (RFP) or an Invitation for Bid (IFB). It is a market research tool being used to determine the availability and adequacy of potential sources for planning purposes only. Responses to this notice are not considered as offers and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. The Government does not intend to award a contract on the basis of responses nor otherwise pay for the preparation of any information presented or the use of any such information. 1. Purpose The Joint Project Manager for Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Nuclear Protection (JPM CBRN P) is conducting a market survey to identify industry capabilities, experience, and potential approaches for serving as a Product Support Integrator (PSI) and material integration support for the Chemically Protected Deployable Medical System (CP DEPMEDS) Reconfiguration and Technology Refresh effort. The Government seeks a commercial partner capable of procuring and coordinating the delivery of commercially available components; receiving, tracking, and consolidating Government-sourced components; applying Item Unique Identification (IUID) markings as required; maintaining materiel accountability and readiness; conducting Preventative Maintenance, Checks and Services (PMCS) and Care of Supply in Storage (COSIS) as necessary, and delivering verified, complete component packages to Pine Bluff Arsenal (PBA) for final system integration, build completion, and packaging. This RFI is issued solely for planning and market-research purposes. It does not constitute a solicitation, request for proposal, commitment by the Government, or authorization to incur costs. The Government will not reimburse respondents for costs associated with preparing or submitting a response. 2. Background CP DEPMEDS is a fielded CBRN protection system that supports Army Role 3 field-hospital operations. The program is executing a reconfiguration and technology-refresh effort using fielded, previously qualified, and commercially available components. The revised support concept under consideration would use a commercial PSI to integrate component procurement, Government-furnished or Government-sourced materiel coordination, traceability, IUID marking, and delivery to Pine Bluff Arsenal (PBA). PBA would retain responsibility for final assembly/integration of CP DEPMEDS sets, final packaging, associated Government acceptance activities, and delivery of sets to their fielding/final destination. 3. Scope of Information Requested The Government seeks information on industry capability to perform the following functions: A. Commercial Component Procurement Procure commercially available components identified by the Government. Conduct vendor management and order placement of components. Identify long-lead items, supply-chain constraints, discontinuance risks, and proposed alternate sources. Provide proposed substitutes only when specifically authorized by the Government. Manage warranties, vendor documentation, certificates of conformance, and commercial shipping documentation as applicable. B. Government Component Coordination Coordinate receipt, transfer, and consolidation of Government-sourced components from designated Government organizations, depots, supply activities, or other locations. Maintain accountability for Government-provided or Government-directed materiel while in contractor custody. Maintain COSIS to prevent environmental degradation, corrosion, and shelf life expiration of stored equipment and supplies. Reconcile shipping discrepancies, damaged materiel, shortages, overages, and documentation issues. Maintain traceability between each component, its source, and its assigned CP DEPMEDS configuration or set. Note: The contractor would not independently obligate Government funds or direct Government supply activities. The Government would retain authority for requisitions, funding, release, acceptance, and disposition decisions. C. IUID and Asset Identification Apply, validate, and document IUID markings for designated end items and components in accordance with Government-furnished requirements and applicable standards. Verify marking quality, placement, readability, and association with the correct item record. Maintain item-level records linking serial number, part number, National Stock Number, Unique Item Identifier, source, and destination. Provide electronic IUID and asset-accountability data deliverables in a Government-specified format. D. Materiel Receiving, Inspection, and Staging Receive and inspect commercial and Government-sourced components. Verify quantities, part numbers, serial numbers, condition, shelf life, and required documentation. Store and stage components in a manner that preserves condition, supports shelf-life management, and enables rapid consolidation into required delivery packages. Maintain COSIS to prevent environmental degradation, corrosion, and shelf life expiration of stored equipment and supplies. E. Kit Completion and Delivery to PBA Build component-level shipping packages in accordance with Government-approved bills of material, configuration lists, and delivery priorities. Conduct kit-completeness checks before shipment. Package, preserve, mark, and ship components to PBA in accordance with Government-approved shipping instructions. Provide advance-shipment notifications, packing lists, serial-number/IUID records, and discrepancy reports. If required, travel to PBA to help support the delivery and inventory of shipped equipment. F. Program Management and Reporting Maintain an integrated procurement and delivery schedule. Provide recurring status reports addressing procurement status, component availability, shortages, long-lead risks, delivery forecasts, IUID status, kit completion, and shipment status. Identify risks early and recommend mitigation actions, including alternate vendors, phased deliveries, or proposed substitutes. Participate in Government-led integrated product team meetings as required. 4. Desired Capabilities Respondents should describe experience performing comparable work involving: Multi-vendor procurement and materiel integration; Government-furnished property or Government-directed materiel; IUID marking, validation, and data management; Military logistics, asset accountability, and shipping documentation; Kitting, staging, packaging, preservation, and shipment of complex equipment; Supply-chain risk management and long-lead-item mitigation; CBRN, deployable medical, field-hospital, shelter, or comparable expeditionary equipment. (Note: This is desired experience but not required for response.) The Government is particularly interested in respondents able to manage multiple sources of supply and coordinate delivery of components to a Government integration location. 5. Industry Response Instructions Responses should not exceed [15] pages, excluding attachments. Include: Company Information: Name, UEI, CAGE code, business size, socioeconomic status, and points of contact. Relevant Experience: Up to three relevant efforts performed within the past five years. Technical Approach: Notional approach to commercial procurement, Government-component coordination, IUID, accountability, staging, kit verification, and delivery to PBA. Facilities and Workforce: Relevant facilities, quality systems, logistics staff, IUID capability, and geographic support model. Data and Reporting: Proposed methods for inventory visibility, serialized-item traceability, IUID data delivery, and Government status reporting. Risk Management: Principal risks, including vendor lead time, part obsolescence, Government materiel availability, configuration changes, and transportation delays. Rough-Order-of-Magnitude: Estimated startup period, staffing approach, major

title: Sources Sought Synopsis (SSS) for Repair of C-5 Moving Island Actuators
description: UPDATE � 16 November 2026: USAF overhaul manual 9H2-4-185-3 has been added to the list of attachments in this posting. To request access to this document, please: 1. Submit access request through SAM.gov 2. Email a copy of your approved, active DD Form 2345 to: Contracting Officer: Jeanette Jordan, jeanette.jordan.2@us.af.mil Contracting Specialist: Lyntasia Harris, lyntasia.harris@us.af.mil __________________________________________________________________ This is a Sources Sought Synopsis (SSS) for market research purposes only and is not a request for proposal, request for quotation, or an invitation for bid. The 409th Supply Chain Management Squadron at Robins Air Force Base is seeking to identify potential sources with the technical expertise, qualifications, and capabilities necessary to provide repair and overhaul services for C-5 Moving Island Actuators. Due to the critical flight safety nature of these components, the repair effort is restricted to approved sources. The government has attached the approved Source Qualification Statement (SQS) to this notice to allow potential alternative sources the maximum amount of time to review the technical requirements and initiate the qualification process. description: Los Servicios Científico-Técnicos (SCT) de la UIB disponen únicamente de un equipo de GC-MS de cuadrupolo adquirido el año 2005, el cual ha presentado problemas de conectividad y de adquisición de cromatogramas durante los últimos meses, llegando a estar largos períodos averiado, con el consiguiente perjuicio de los usuarios y el desarrollo de sus proyectos de investigación. Debido su antigüedad resulta muy complicado conseguir algunas piezas de recambio para su reparación. Además, el analizador del GC ha quedado obsoleto y no permite la ejecución de análisis MS/MS ni métodos de cribado ni métodos no-dirigidos. El objetivo de este contrato es adquirir un analizador de alta resolución (Q/TOF u Orbitrap) acoplado a GC que permita desarrollar tanto métodos de identificación como cuantificación, en análisis dirigidos, de sospechosos y no-dirigidos mediante MS/MS, con mejor sensibilidad que el analizador disponible en la actualidad. Por ello, en estos momentos, los SCT no son capaces de ofrecer un servicio adecuado acorde a las necesidades de sus usuarios, al no disponer de ningún equipamiento funcional de GC-MS para la determinación cualitativa y cuantitativa de compuestos orgánicos volátiles y semivolátiles en muestras de origen ambiental, biológico, alimentario e industrial presentadas en los diferentes estados de agregación de la materia. El objeto del contrato coincide con el equipo financiado por la Agencia Estatal de Investigación en la ayuda EQC2025-009163.

title: Denmark – Washing and dry-cleaning services – Kontrakt for vask og leje (2026)
description: Udbuddet gennemføres af Tårnby Kommune i samarbejde med Dragør Kommune. Udbuddet omfatter vask og leje af tekstiler inden for det sundhedsfaglige område til både Tårnby Kommune og Dragør Kommune og består af følgende to delaftaler: • Delaftale 1: Vask og leje af arbejdsbeklædning • Delaftale 2: Vask og leje af linned Tilbudsgiver kan vælge at afgive tilbud på en eller begge delaftaler. Et tilbud på en delaftale skal omfatte det samlede udbudte forbrug under den pågældende delaftale for både Tårnby Kommune og Dragør Kommune. Det er således ikke muligt at afgive tilbud alene på en af kommunernes forbrug inden for en delaftale. Delaftalerne evalueres og tildeles særskilt. Den enkelte delaftale tildeles den tilbudsgiver, der har afgivet det økonomisk mest fordelagtige tilbud på den pågældende delaftale i overensstemmelse med den evalueringsmodel, der fremgår af udbudsmaterialet. Den samme tilbudsgiver kan således tildeles en eller begge delaftaler. Tilbud, der ikke omfatter begge kommuners samlede udbudte forbrug inden for den eller de delaftaler, som tilbudsgiver afgiver tilbud på, vil blive betragtet som ukonditionsmæssigt. På baggrund af tildelingen underskrives kontrakten særskilt for hver kommune. Der vil således blive indgået en kontrakt mellem den vindende tilbudsgiver og Tårnby Kommune og en kontrakt mellem den vindende tilbudsgiver og Dragør Kommune for hver delaftale, som tilbudsgiveren tildeles. Kontrakterne har som udgangspunkt samme ordlyd og indeholder de samme vilkår. Der kan dog være forskelle i bestemmelserne om kommunernes arbejdsklausuler, som er tilpasset den enkelte kommune. De delaftalespecifikke krav fremgår af kontrakternes respektive bilag. Udbudsbetingelserne med tilhørende bilag udgør sammen med den enkelte kontrakt det samlede kontraktgrundlag. Udbuddet gennemføres via EU-Supply, hvor det samlede udbudsmateriale er offentligt tilgængeligt. Ved behov for support eller systemtekniske spørgsmål i forbindelse med udbuddet henvises til EU-Supply på e-mail dksupport@eu-supply.com eller telefon +45 7020 8014.

title: New Meadows Range Barn
description: A. This project consists of modifying an existing waterline and replacing a water hydrant, removing an existing wood deck and constructing a new metal deck, replacing the existing roof, abatement of lead-based paint, removing lead-based paint siding, installing new siding, and preparing and painting exterior surfaces of the New Meadows Range Barn located at the New Meadows Barracks administrative site located at 100 S Norris Ave. New Meadows, ID 83654. B. Base work includes the following described below: 1. Removal of existing roofing, installation of plywood sheathing over the existing skip sheathing, installation of ice/water shield over the entire roof, and installation of new corrugated metal roofing. 2. Abatement of lead-based paint of rafter tails, soffit, & fascia; and painting of aforementioned surfaces. 3. Removal of lead-based paint siding and felt paper, installation of plywood sheathing and building wrap, installation of new siding in-kind, installation of new trim in-kind around the windows, doors, and corners and painting of all aforementioned surfaces. 4. Replacement of approximately 10-feet of existing 1-inch SIDR 9 HDPE waterline including moving the existing hydrant location 2-feet to the east along the side of the building and replacement of the existing hydrant with a new hydrant and drainage basin. Additionally, replacement of an existing galvanized barb fitting with a brass barb fitting is required. C. Optional work includes the following described below: 1. Removal of existing wood decking and foundation piers and fabrication and installation of new expanded metal decking with steps over a metal frame with new foundation piers. D. Quantities associated with these options are identified in the Schedule of Items

title: JOFOC-Clinical East Staffing
description: The Government proposes a noncompetitive modification to Task Order 75P00123F37008, issued under Contract HHSP233201800009I, to provide interim bridge services while FOH completes the competitive follow-on acquisition and transition. The proposed modification would establish a six-month base period, November 1, 2026 through April 30, 2027, and one six-month option, May 1 through October 31, 2027. The proposed modification will increase the total estimated cost of the task order by $19,978,602.20, from $62,094,434.91 to $82,073,037.11. Performance will be limited to the services and duration supported by the approved justification and implemented through the executed modification. Task Order 75P00123F37008 (Clinical East), issued under IDIQ Contract HHSP233201800009I, is a time and-materials (T&M) task order with ServeFed, Inc. Before execution of the proposed modification, the Contracting Officer will confirm the applicable contract-type requirements, review the availability of any existing determination and findings (D&F), and document the basis for continued use of T&M or any proposed change in contract type. The proposed modification is necessary to maintain uninterrupted mission-essential services while the Government completes and awards the competitive follow-on acquisition. The recompete is currently under development but will not be completed before expiration of the existing contract on October 31, 2026. The Government anticipates award of the bridge modification in October 2026, using FY 2027 Service Supply funds, subject to availability and proper obligation of funds. The proposed bridge period is November 1, 2026 through October 31, 2027. The Government intends to transition to the competitively awarded follow-on contract as soon as practicable and does not intend to use the entire bridge period if transition to the successor contractor can occur earlier. The Government plans to solicit for the recompete in FY27.

title: Intent Notice: Materials Management Software System for Lower Brule Health Center in Lower Brule, SD
description: The Great Plains Area Indian Health Service hereby submits a notice of intent to award a sole source, Firm Fixed-Price, purchase order for Materials Management Software System Service that is associated with the Lower Brule Health Center located in Lower Brule, SD. This service will allow the service unit staff to monitor all service unit supplies and inventory and outdates as well as E-ordering needed for day-to-day operations in the outpatient clinic and services the Lower Brule Health Center provides. The period of performance will be for one year from the Date of Award, with four (4) option years should the service unit see the need to exercise those options. This sole source contracting action is pursuing a waiver from placing an order on a competitive basis pursuant to FAR 6.302-1, only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements and is based on this vendor is the sole company that can provide this service due to it being the only vendor deemed acceptable by IHS. The total estimated value for the base year is $14,256.00, and including all options is $89,520.00. Responses to this notice must demonstrate clear and convincing evidence that sole source would not be advantageous to the Government, would not be cost or time prohibitive, and would not hinder the mission objective of our agency standardization. The determination not to compete this proposed contract action is solely within the discretion of the Government. Information received will normally be considered for the purposes of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement. The Government will not be responsible for any costs incurred by responding to this notice. This is NOT a request for quotes or proposals. Questions or comments to this Notice of Intent should be directed to Jeremiah Tsoodle, Purchasing Agent via email only at jeremiah.tsoodle@ihs.gov (phone calls/voice mail messages regarding questions will not be accepted and will not receive a response). Please indicate in the subject of your email: Notice of Intent Question Submission � IHS152702, Materials Management Software System.

description: The Government proposes a noncompetitive modification to Task Order 75P00123F37007, issued under Contract HHSP233201800009I, to provide interim bridge services while FOH completes the competitive follow-on acquisition and transition. The proposed modification would establish a seven-month base period, November 1, 2026 through May 31, 2027, and one five-month option, June 1 through October 31, 2027. The proposed modification will increase the total estimated cost of the task order by $6,690,504.50, from $23,999,068.73 to $30,689,573.23. Performance will be limited to the services and duration supported by the approved justification and implemented through the executed modification. Contract HHSP233201800009I / 75P00123F37007 (West) is an Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ), Time and Materials (T&M) Task Order with ServeFed, Inc. A Determination and Findings for a T&M type task order was not found in the base contract file that was transferred from WorkSmarter to HCAS. However, a D&F approved by the CO is included in the award file with this modification. The proposed modification is necessary to maintain uninterrupted mission-essential services while the Government completes and awards the competitive follow-on acquisition. The recompete is currently under development but will not be completed before expiration of the existing contract on October 31, 2026. The Government anticipates award of the bridge modification in October 2026, using FY 2027 Service Supply funds, subject to availability and proper obligation of funds. The proposed bridge period is November 1, 2026 through October 31, 2027. The Government intends to transition to the competitively awarded follow-on contract as soon as practicable and does not intend to use the entire bridge period if transition to the successor contractor can occur earlier. The Government plans to solicit for the recompete in FY27.

title: Kontrakt for vask og leje (2026)
description: Udbuddet gennemføres af Tårnby Kommune i samarbejde med Dragør Kommune. Udbuddet omfatter vask og leje af tekstiler inden for det sundhedsfaglige område til både Tårnby Kommune og Dragør Kommune og består af følgende to delaftaler: • Delaftale 1: Vask og leje af arbejdsbeklædning • Delaftale 2: Vask og leje af linned Tilbudsgiver kan vælge at afgive tilbud på en eller begge delaftaler. Et tilbud på en delaftale skal omfatte det samlede udbudte forbrug under den pågældende delaftale for både Tårnby Kommune og Dragør Kommune. Det er således ikke muligt at afgive tilbud alene på en af kommunernes forbrug inden for en delaftale. Delaftalerne evalueres og tildeles særskilt. Den enkelte delaftale tildeles den tilbudsgiver, der har afgivet det økonomisk mest fordelagtige tilbud på den pågældende delaftale i overensstemmelse med den evalueringsmodel, der fremgår af udbudsmaterialet. Den samme tilbudsgiver kan således tildeles en eller begge delaftaler. Tilbud, der ikke omfatter begge kommuners samlede udbudte forbrug inden for den eller de delaftaler, som tilbudsgiver afgiver tilbud på, vil blive betragtet som ukonditionsmæssigt. På baggrund af tildelingen underskrives kontrakten særskilt for hver kommune. Der vil således blive indgået en kontrakt mellem den vindende tilbudsgiver og Tårnby Kommune og en kontrakt mellem den vindende tilbudsgiver og Dragør Kommune for hver delaftale, som tilbudsgiveren tildeles. Kontrakterne har som udgangspunkt samme ordlyd og indeholder de samme vilkår. Der kan dog være forskelle i bestemmelserne om kommunernes arbejdsklausuler, som er tilpasset den enkelte kommune. De delaftalespecifikke krav fremgår af kontrakternes respektive bilag. Udbudsbetingelserne med tilhørende bilag udgør sammen med den enkelte kontrakt det samlede kontraktgrundlag. Udbuddet gennemføres via EU-Supply, hvor det samlede udbudsmateriale er offentligt tilgængeligt. Ved behov for support eller systemtekniske spørgsmål i forbindelse med udbuddet henvises til EU-Supply på e-mail dksupport@eu-supply.com eller telefon +45 7020 8014.

description: The Department of Justice (DOJ), Office of the Inspector General (OIG) intends to negotiate on a sole source basis with Washington Metropolitan Area Transit Authority (WMATA), utilizing an open market simplified acquisition procedure tool for a Firm Fixed-Price (FFP) contract. The purpose of this FFP contract is to establish a purchase order that will enable the DOJ OIG the ability to continue to provide its transit benefit program to the employees in the Washington D.C. metropolitan area. The NAICS code for this contract action is 485111 - Mixed Mode Transit Systems (SBA Size Standard: $29.0 Million). The Product Service Code for this action is V229 - Transportation/Travel/Relocation- Travel/Lodging/Recruitment: Purchase of Transit/Public Transportation Fare Media. Based on market research, DOJ OIG has deemed that the requirement being sought can only be fulfilled by one responsible source (Washington Metropolitan Area Transit Authority) and no other sources can satisfy the agency�s requirement. In accordance with Public Law 103-172 �Federal Employees Clean Air Incentives Act� (5 U.S.C., Section 7905), the DOJ OIG has established a transit benefit program for employees. WMATA is the only source to offer access to a comprehensive mass transportation system in the Washington D.C. metropolitan area that includes the required modes of transportation such as WMATA subway and bus system, commuter van pools, Maryland Area Regional Commuter (MARC) transit, Virginia Railway Express (VRE), Maryland Transit Administration (MTA) Commuter Bus and MetroAccess. It is recommended that the requirement be procured via a utilizing an open market sole source simplified acquisition procedure, utilizing authority found in FAR 13.106-1 (b)(1)(i). This notice of intent is not a request for quotations. Any party who believes they can fulfil this requirement should provide a capabilities statement no later than Sunday, November 29, 2026 at 7:00 am ET. The capabilities statement must provide clear and unambiguous evidence to substantiate the capability of the party to provide the requirement. A determination not to compete this proposed contract upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Verbal responses are not acceptable and will not be considered. When responding to this announcement, respondents should refer to Announcement 15G1AC27N00000001. If by Sunday, November 29, 2026, no viable responses have been received in response to this announcement, DOJ OIG shall negotiate solely with Washington Metropolitan Area Transit Authority. Any prospective contractor must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) and in order to be eligible for award. Interested parties are encouraged to furnish information. All documents submitted will not be returned. All interested parties shall submit clear and convincing documentation demonstrating their capabilities to satisfy the requirements listed above to Contracting Officer, Johao Stewart by email at johao.stewart@usdoj.gov. The capability documentation should include general information and specific technical background describing in detail the prospective contractor's capabilities and experience that will demonstrate the ability to support these requirements.

title: US COAST GUARD NSFCC CONFINED SPACE TRAINING
description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial services prepared in accordance with the format in FAR subpart 12.6 and part 13, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotations are being requested and a written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number 34359RFQ270000002 is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ). This solicitation document and incorporated provisions and clauses are those in effect through Federal Acquisition Circular 2021-05, effective 10 March 2021. The applicable North American Industry Classification Standard NAICS Code is 541990. This solicitation is 100% Set-Aside for Small Business. All responsible sources may submit a quotation which shall be considered by the agency. It is anticipated that a firm-fixed price purchase order will be awarded for the item found below as a result of this synopsis/solicitation: Equivalent items requested in this solicitation will be considered for award.. SPECIFICATIONS: The United States Coast Guard (USCG) National Strike Force (NSF) requires contractor support (training materials, equipment, and services) for instruction of Confined Space and Rescue Training for personnel in personal protective equipment for Level A and B responses in accordance with the attached Statement of Work. The final day will be dedicated to a skills exercise to evaluate how well participants apply the knowledge gained during the week's training. The contract will have a one-year period of performance. The Contractor will provide three (3) course convenings of up to twenty (20) students for Confined Space Entry Training and up to 12 students (that had the Confined Space Entry Course) for Confined Space Rescue Training. Both courses and exercise should be completed within 5 days (example: 2 days Entry, 2 days Rescue and 1 day skill exercise or something similar) and be completed prior to the last day of September 2027. The USCG will own the training courses, and a copy of all training materials created for the course shall be provided to the NSF. An audit will be completed to update material as needed due to regulation changes, mission changes and all other unforeseen circumstances. All training classes shall take place at USCG facilities. The primary place of performance will be at the three National Strike Force Strike Teams (NSFSTs). The Government will provide all classroom facilities. There will be one convening per location. The locations of the three NSFSTs are: Atlantic Strike Team: Fort Dix, New Jersey Gulf Strike Team: Mobile, Alabama Pacific Strike Team: Novato, California

title: Hankinta Kankaanpään kaupungin koulukuljetukselle reitille Kankaanpää - Karvia
description: Hankinta Kankaanpään kaupungin koulukuljetukselle reitille Kankaanpää - Karvia Kankaanpään kaupungin (tilaaja) tarjouspyyntö koskien koulukuljetuspalveluja esi- ja perusopetuksen oppilaille reitille Keskusta - Karvia lukuvuosille 2026 – 2027 ja 2027 - 2028 ajalle 4.1.2027 - 30.6.2028 ja optiokaudet lukuvuosiksi 2028-2029 ja 2029-2030. Optioiden käyttöönotosta päättää tilaaja. Hankinnan arvo on optiot mukaan lukien noin 210 000 euroa. Koulukuljetukset tapahtuvat koulun toiminta-aikoina, n. 190 päivänä vuodessa. Tilaaja ilmoittaa koulun toiminta-ajat vuosittain etukäteen. Kuljetusreitit ja -määrät ovat alustavia ja ne on esitetty tämänhetkisen tiedon mukaisina. Koulukuljetusten reitit ja suoritteet tarkistetaan elokuun alkupuolella, kun on käytettävissä lopulliset tiedot oppilaista ja kuljetusajoista. Tarkistukset tehdään tilaajan ja valittujen sopimuskumppaneiden kanssa yhteistyössä. Sopimuskumppani laatii reitin kuljetusaikataulut annettujen tietojen perusteella. Tilaaja hyväksyy lopulliset reittisuunnitelmat ja aikataulut. Tilaaja pidättää itsellään oikeuden reittien muutokseen jaksojärjestelmästä, lukukauden vaihtumisesta, lukujärjestyksen tai oppilasmäärien muutoksesta tms. johtuen. Ennen muutoksista tehtävää päätöstä neuvotellaan palveluntuottajan kanssa. Lukujärjestyksistä ym. muista seikoista johtuvat päivittäiset muutokset palveluntuottaja ottaa huomioon kunkin kohteen kuljetuksessa. Päävastuu reitin ja aikataulujen toimivuudesta ja täsmällisyydestä kuuluu palveluntuottajalle.,

title: Overhaul of English Electric/GEC EA2 power turbines
description: Overhaul of English Electric/GEC EA2 power turbines This procurement consists of overhaul of one (1) English Electric/GEC EA2 power turbine. The overhaul of Huutokoski unit 5 will take place in 2027. In addition to this, overhaul of four (4) English Electric/GEC EA2 power turbines, shall be quoted as mandatory options 1, 2, 3 and 4 (“Options”). The schedule for executing these options shall be decided later, but are preliminarily planned for years 2028 - 2031. The preliminary scope of supply for Huutokoski unit 5 overhaul consists of: 1) Disassembly of the power turbine to a level in which the rotor discs and stator vanes are removed from the unit 2) Inspection of all relevant parts, components and assemblies. Measurement and record of relevant clearances and dimensions 3) Supply and replacement of all consumables and one life components 4) Supply and replacement of all other potentially required spare parts 5) Repair of any damaged parts, components and assemblies 6) Reassembly of the unit 7) Commissioning The same scope of supply shall be quoted for the Options.,

description: Die Baumaßnahme Ortskern Volksdorf beinhaltet die Umgestaltung des Straßenzuges zu einem Verkehrsberuhigten Geschäftsbereich. Dies bedeutet die Weiterführung der bereits derzeit geltenden Einbahnstraßenregelung, die Einrichtung einer Tempo-20-Zone (VZ 274.1) sowie die Einrichtung als eingeschränkte Halteverbotszone (VZ 290.1) in Verbindung mit der Erlaubnis, in gekennzeichneten Bereichen z. B. zwei Stunden lang parken zu dürfen (VZ 1040-33). Die Einrichtung eines Verkehrsberuhigten Geschäftsbereiches bietet insbesondere in den Nebenflächen Raum für vielfältige Nutzungsmöglichkeiten. Angelehnt an die Erfahrungen aus der Flaniermeile Volksdorf würde die Reduzierung des Parksuchverkehrs zu einer Verkehrsberuhigung und somit zu einer verbesserten Aufenthaltsqualität im Projektgebiet führen. Es können beispielsweise Elemente wie mehr Parkbänke, Pflanzbeete, kleine Spielinseln für Kinder oder Nutzungsmöglichkeiten durch Außengastronomie installiert werden, die zu einer Belebung des Straßenzuges und zu einer signifikanten Verbesserung der Aufenthaltsqualität sowie der Verweilzeit vor Ort beitragen. Ziel ist die Umsetzung der Planung für einen Verkehrsberuhigten Geschäftsbereich, ggf. mit der Entwicklung verschiedener denkbarer Untervarianten. Als Bestandteil im Planungsverlauf ist die Beteiligung der Öffentlichkeit vorgesehen. Das Format und der jeweilige Umfang der Beteiligung müssen noch abgestimmt werden. Dennoch sollte es für die Öffentlichkeit die Möglichkeit geben, sich aktiv in den Gestaltungsprozess vor Ort mit einbringen zu können, damit die Bürgerinnen und Bürger zum Beispiel an der Positionierung von Sitzbänken oder grüner Inseln im Straßenzug aktiv mitarbeiten können. title: Germany – Internet service providers ISP – Gemeinde Pfaffenhofen a.d. Roth - Gigabit-RL 2.0 (2025)-Auswahlverfahren / Dienstleistungskonzession im Wirtschaftlichkeitslückenmodell für die Planung, Errichtung und den Betrieb eines Gigabit-Netzes
description: Verhandlungsverfahren mit Teilnahmewettbewerb entsprechend § 12 KonzVgV i.V.m. § 14 Abs. 2, Abs. 3 Nr. 2, Nr. 3 VgV, § 119 Abs. 5 GWB (zweistufiges Verhandlungsverfahren) zur Bestimmung eines Netzbetreibers für die Planung, die Errichtung und den Betrieb eines Gigabit-Netzes im Wirtschaftlichkeitslückenmodell in den ausgeschriebenen Ausbaugebieten nach Maßgabe der Richtlinie "Förderung zur Unterstützung des Gigabitausbau der Telekommunikationsnetze in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland" vom 31.03.2023 in der Fassung der 2. Änderung vom 13.01.2025 (nachfolgend "Gigabit-RL 2.0"). Wesentliche Grundlage des Verfahrens sind die "Rahmenregelung der Bundesrepublik Deutschland zur Unterstützung des flächendeckenden Aufbaus von Gigabitnetzen" vom 01.08.2024 (nachfolgend "Gigabit-RR 2.0"), die Richtlinie "Förderung zur Unterstützung des Gigabitausbaus der Telekommunikationsnetze in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland" vom 31.03.2023 in der Fassung der 2. Änderung vom 13.01.2025 (nachfolgend Gigabit-RL 2.0) sowie die Mitteilung der Europäischen Union "Leitlinien für staatliche Beihilfen zur Förderung von Breitbandnetzen" vom 31.01.2023 (2023/C 36/01). Die ausgeschriebenen Adressen des Erschließungsgebietes sind nach Ergebnis der Markterkundung förderfähige unterversorgte Adressen im Sinne der Gigabit-RL 2.0. Aus diesem Grund soll dort auf Basis dieses Auswahlverfahrens ein Gigabit-Netz als technologieneutrale Netzbezeichnung (Netz mit einer Breitbandversorgung von mindestens 1 Gbit/s symmetrisch zu Spitzenlastzeitbedingungen für alle Endnutzer der ausgeschriebenen Adressen) in den unterversorgten Gebieten errichtet werden, wobei sich die Up- und Downloadraten mindestens verdoppeln müssen. Auf die Vorgaben der "B-Leistungsbeschreibung" inkl. deren Anlagen wird ergänzend verwiesen. Der Konzessionsgeber ordnet den ausgeschriebenen "Vertrag über die Weiterleitung von Zuwendungen im Rahmen des Gigabitausbaus in der Marktgemeinde Pfaffenhofen a.d. Roth zum Zwecke der Planung, der Errichtung und des Betriebs eines gigabitfähigen Breitbandnetzes im Wirtschaftlichkeitslückenmodell nach der Richtlinie "Förderung zur Unterstützung des Gigabitausbaus der Telekommunikationsnetze in der Bundesrepublik Deutschland - Gigabit-Richtlinie des Bundes 2.0 (Gigabit-RL 2.0)" als eine Dienstleistungskonzession i.S.d. § 105 Abs. 1 Nr. 2 GWB ein. Der Konzessionsgeber überträgt damit die ihm als Aufgabe der Daseinsvorsorge obliegende Realisierung der Versorgung der Bevölkerung mit Gigabitanschlüssen auf den Konzessionsnehmer, welcher das Nutzungsrecht am Gigabit-Netz erhält und die Vergütung für seine Tätigkeit in erster Linie durch die Entgelte der Endkunden erhält, während der Konzessionsgeber lediglich einen Zuschuss zur Deckung der gegebenenfalls ausgewiesenen Wirtschaftlichkeitslücke leistet, welcher nach § 105 Abs. 1 Nr. 2 GWB einer Dienstleistungskonzession nicht entgegensteht. Der Schwerpunkt der Tätigkeit des Konzessionsnehmers liegt auf der Dienstleistung des Betreibens des Breitbandnetzes über den Zeitraum von mindestens sieben Jahren. Der Konzessionsgeber ordnet weiter das zu planende, zu bauende und zu betreibende Gigabit-Netz auch als ein "öffentliches Kommunikationsnetz" i.S.d. Bereichsausnahme gemäß § 149 Nr. 8 GWB ein, so dass der 4. Teil des GWB nicht zur Anwendung kommt. Soweit in den Unterlagen des Auswahlverfahrens auf Normen des 4. Teils des GWB verwiesen wird, begründet dies keinen Anspruch auf deren Anwendbarkeit.

Die Vertragslaufzeit beträgt grundsätzlich maximal 24 Monate beginnend frühestens mit dem 01.12.2024 (ggf. abweichende Startzeiten ergeben sich aus den Angaben beim entsprechenden Los). Der Vertrag endet spätestens am 30.11.2026 (evtl. Ausnahmen ergeben sich aus den Angaben beim entsprechenden Los), unabhängig vom Datum des Vertragsschlusses. Ein Beitritt zu diesem Open-House-Verfahren ist innerhalb der Vertragslaufzeit jederzeit möglich. Alle weiteren Informationen sind den Teilnahme- und Vertragsunterlagen zu entnehmen.

Sweden – Forestry services – Prekvalificeringssystem inom kategorin helikoptertoppning av kantträd
description: Vattenfall Eldistribution AB bjuder härmed in er som leverantör till att delta i och prekvalificera för att delta i kommande upphandlingar inom kategorin Helikoptertoppning av Kantträd. Endast leverantörer som är prekvalificerade och återfinns i prekvalificeringssystemet kommer att bjudas in för att delta i framtida upphandlingar. Annonsering av prekvalificeringssystemet kommer att ske löpande i enlighet med de tidsramar som framgår av denna inbjudan. Prekvalificeringssystemets giltighetstid är 12 månader från den 1 december 2024 till och med den 30 november 2025 och förnyas därefter genom att den upphandlande enheten företar en ny annonsering. Samtliga prekvalificerade leverantörer kommer den 1 oktober 2025 att få ett meddelande om huruvida en ny prekvalificering kommer att behöva genomföras för kategorin. Prekvalificeringssystemet kommer att nyttjas i samband med upphandlingar av enskilda kontrakt inom kategorin. Tilldelning av kontrakt i kommande upphandlingar kommer att ske till det mest ekonomiskt fördelaktigaste anbudet där kriterierna pris, eller pris i förhållande till kvalitet kommer ligga till grund för utvärdering av inkomna anbud. I begreppet kvalitet omfattas även hållbarhetskriterier. Ni som leverantör erbjuds att registrera sig i prekvalificeringssystemet för att kunna delta i framtida upphandlingar inom kategorin och registreringen är kostnadsfri. För att vara godkänd i detta prekvalificeringssystem och delta i framtida upphandlingar måste man som leverantör vara registrerad i Achilles (Vattenfall Supplier Bank). Ni finner Achilles på följande adress: Supplier registration - Vattenfall (https://group.vattenfall.com/who-we-are/suppliers/supplier-registration).
